original.statement: The high-scale mode for ipcache is deprecated in 1.17 and will be removed in v1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-21e07cf98d97] says "The high-scale mode for ipcache has been deprecated and will be removed in v1.18". That is a deprecation of something that still works, so the change type "deprecated" is right. The evidence does not name the flag, config key or Helm value that enables the mode. So a free-form subject built from its own words ("ipcache-high-scale-mode") is the closest identity the evidence supports. The "Deprecated Options" heading suggests a config option behind it, so the family choice is uncertain and confidence is low.
